scope: Read-only source mechanism audit, no native observations or role implementation

findings.fact: read() creates a NEW read_data object with buffer/bufaddr/parseaddr and invokes Glk.glk_request_line_event_uni on current main/upper input window. read_char has a different read_data shape. read_data existence alone persists and is not readiness.

Window object line_request=true, line_request_uni=true, input_generation=g and linebuf=buffer. Accepted line handler clears line_request flags,input_generation,linebuf before e.resume(); cancellation also clears these fields. Saved/restore path can reconstruct requests, so generation alone is not command identity.
Real ordinary submit stamp exists: ++_submissionId with pageEpoch, carried in accepted event and _activeTurn. This differs from UndoRestoreSync.generation.

450ms settle timer is attribution boundary, not a VM pending-input guarantee. _boundaryStamp can capture before a later command begins. Analyzer contract disallows reading live VM in analyze(); captureAfter owns snapshot.
Timeline generation handles undo/restore/restart; ordinary command freshness must not be inferred from it alone.

designImplications: Proposed readiness can bind actual current VM/window/read_data references and active line_request/linebuf/input_generation; validate supplied mem is current VM memory. Neither visible DOM prompt nor WorldModel.tick nor elapsed timer alone proves a settled VM input request.
Use existing accepted-submission pageEpoch/submissionId plus restore generation and input request identity for freshness; do not call input_generation a turn number.

Recheck same current pending request plus current singular role/room before submitting a generated command. Request disappearance/replacement, group/invalid role or module/restore change invalidates old selection.

These are source-supported candidate seams, not an agreed new public API, no current role fact/code permission. Native validation of request lifecycle across commands/restore/char input still required.
